title: Reading Excel's pooled two-sample t-test output
scenario_markdown:
A manufacturer compares independent production lines A and B. Each line has 15 randomly sampled cycle times (minutes). The sample means are 78.4 and 72.1; sample variances are 24.5 and 20.2. Assume normal populations with equal variances. Test $H_0:\mu_A-\mu_B=0$ against $H_1:\mu_A-\mu_B\ne0$ at $\alpha=0.05$.

Excel-style output (A minus B):

- Pooled Variance: 22.3500
- df: 28
- t Stat: 3.6495
- P(T<=t) one-tail: 0.0005
- P(T<=t) two-tail: 0.0011
- t Critical one-tail: 1.7011
- t Critical two-tail: 2.0484
assumptions: The samples are independent; times within each sample are independent.
Populations are normal with equal variances; the pooled method is stipulated, not confirmed as the course convention.
The alternative is two-sided and alpha was chosen before inspecting the data.

stages.prompt_markdown: Which p-value should the two-sided test report? Select the value rounded to four decimal places.

options.hint_markdown: Do not halve a two-sided p-value.
Alpha is the decision threshold, not the observed p-value.

stages.explanation_markdown: Use the two-tail row because the alternative permits either sign. Excel: `=T.DIST.2T(ABS(t),28)` or `=T.TEST(A2:A16,B2:B16,2,2)` on the original data.

stages.prompt_markdown: Which positive critical t-value applies to this two-sided test at alpha 0.05? Select the value rounded to four decimal places.

options.hint_markdown: The one-tail cutoff allocates all alpha to one tail.
Unknown population variances require a t distribution with df=28.

stages.explanation_markdown: Split alpha between two tails. Excel: `=T.INV.2T(0.05,28)`. Compare the absolute t statistic with this positive cutoff.

stages.prompt_markdown: What conclusion follows from the correct p-value and critical value?

options.text_markdown: Reject H0; there is evidence that the population mean cycle times differ.
Fail to reject H0 because t Stat exceeds 1.
options.hint_markdown: Compare p with alpha, or |t| with the two-tail cutoff.

options.text_markdown: The two population means differ by exactly 6.3 minutes.
options.hint_markdown: The observed sample difference estimates an uncertain population difference.

stages.explanation_markdown: The two-tail p-value is below 0.05 and |t| exceeds the two-tail critical value. Both methods reject the same null. The sample difference is 6.3 minutes; rejection does not establish an exact population difference. The one-tail row is not appropriate for this stated alternative.
